title: Khiladi
desc: A group of four friends decide to play a prank involving the fake kidnapping of one of them and asking for ransom from her father. However, things become complicated when she actually ends up dead.

title: Rudrangi
desc: Bheem Rao Deshmukh, a tyrant who oppresses his people, is drawn to a beautiful woman named Rudrangi and desires physical contact with her. In order to satisfy his obsession, he terrorises her village.

title: Policegiri
desc: Tired of the rampant corruption fueled by Nagori Subramaniam, DCP Rudra takes a defiant stand. He launches a one-man crusade to take down the crime lord and dismantle his criminal syndicate.

title: The Greatest of All Time
desc: After a tragedy tears him apart from his wife, Gandhi, a former elite spy, is forced back into the field for a mission of the utmost importance.

title: Night Drive
desc: A young couple's endeavour to enjoy a night drive is meted out with a terrible punishment when they get into an accident that leads to an investigation followed by more troubles.

title: Rudra Tandava
desc: Shivaraj, a carefree young man, is devastated when a gangster, Narasimha, kills his elder brother. When Narasimha is not arrested by the police, Shivaraj and his father vow to take revenge.

title: Jaane Hoga Kya
desc: Siddharth, a young and ambitious scientist, is determined to create a perfect human clone. When he finally achieves his goal, he realizes that he has unlocked a Pandora's box of horrors.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Khaki
desc: Chiru becomes part of a 'vigilance group', that fights crimes in the neighbourhood. However, their group lands in trouble when a businessman creates problems for them.
